```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

project_dir <- "."
output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Output")
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
input_file <- file.path(project_dir, "Resources", "Supplementary spreadsheet 1.xlsx")
stopifnot(file.exists(input_file))
```

```{r}
# Importing original 143 proteins from spreadsheet
original <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = "S1 PN FL vs. PN deltaCTD Upreg")

eczema_genes <- c(
  "S100A7", "S100A8", "S100A9", "SDC1", "SDC4",
  "CSTA", "HMOX1", "HSP90AA1", "LCN2"
)

proteins <- original %>%
  transmute(
    gene_symbol = trimws(as.character(`Gene Symbol`)),
    uniprot_accession = trimws(as.character(Accession)),
    protein_name = sub(" OS=.*$", "", Description),
    abundance_ratio_FL_vs_DeltaCTD = `Abundance Ratio: (FL) / (DELTA CTR)`,
    adjusted_p_value = `Abundance Ratio Adj. P-Value: (FL) / (DELTA CTR)`,
    peptides = `# Peptides`,
    unique_peptides = `# Unique Peptides`,
    psms = `# PSMs`,
    biological_process = `Biological Process`,
    cellular_component = `Cellular Component`,
    molecular_function = `Molecular Function`,
    # assign graph partitions
    disease_group = if_else(gene_symbol %in% eczema_genes,
                            "Eczema/psoriasis", "Other"),
    # keep OG experimental classification
    experimental_class = if_else(
      as.character(`Exclusively found in PN FL samples`) %in% c("TRUE", "True", "1"),
      "Exclusive to PN FL", "Enriched in PN FL"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Check identifier quality without dropping proteins
missing_symbols <- sum(is.na(proteins$gene_symbol) | proteins$gene_symbol == "")
missing_accessions <- sum(is.na(proteins$uniprot_accession) | proteins$uniprot_accession == "")
duplicate_symbols <- sum(duplicated(proteins$gene_symbol))
duplicate_accessions <- sum(duplicated(proteins$uniprot_accession))

cat("Total protein rows:", nrow(proteins), "\n")
cat("Missing gene symbols:", missing_symbols, "\n")
cat("Missing UniProt accessions:", missing_accessions, "\n")
cat("Duplicate gene symbols:", duplicate_symbols, "\n")
cat("Duplicate UniProt accessions:", duplicate_accessions, "\n\n")
cat("Disease grouping:\n")
print(table(proteins$disease_group))
cat("\nExperimental grouping:\n")
print(table(proteins$experimental_class))

# Matching list to study
stopifnot(
  nrow(proteins) == 143,
  missing_symbols == 0,
  missing_accessions == 0,
  duplicate_symbols == 0,
  duplicate_accessions == 0,
  sum(proteins$disease_group == "Eczema/psoriasis") == 9,
  sum(proteins$experimental_class == "Exclusive to PN FL") == 54
)
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  proteins,
  file.path(output_dir, "eczema_143_proteins_R.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# Export gene symbols for STRING (you can upload this file to STRING website to double check too)
writeLines(
  proteins$gene_symbol,
  file.path(output_dir, "eczema_143_proteins_STRING_R.txt")
)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    all_143_proteins = proteins,
    disease_associated_9 = filter(proteins, disease_group == "Eczema/psoriasis"),
    other_134 = filter(proteins, disease_group == "Other")
  ),
  path = file.path(output_dir, "eczema_protein_analysis_R.xlsx")
)

cat("\nDone: created cleaned CSV, STRING gene list, and Excel workbook\n")
```

```{r}
# STEP 2: Retrieve STRING protein interactions
# Note that this will take a while to run since it's downloading data. Run this block with internet connection!!
library(STRINGdb)

# import cleaned protein data
proteins <- read.csv(
  file.path(output_dir, "eczema_143_proteins_R.csv")
)

stopifnot(nrow(proteins) == 143)

# STRING database initialization
# Typically, the high confidence score used is 700. But I only got 11 bipartite interactions with that, so lowering to default medium confidence of 400.
score_threshold <- 400

string_db <- STRINGdb$new(
  version = "12.5",
  species = 9606,
  score_threshold = score_threshold,
  network_type = "full"
)

# Map gene symbols to STRING ID
mapped <- string_db$map(
  proteins,
  "gene_symbol",
  takeFirst = TRUE,
  removeUnmappedRows = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  mapped,
  file.path(output_dir, "STRING_protein_mapping.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Successful mapped proteins
mapped_ok <- mapped[
  !is.na(mapped$STRING_id) & mapped$STRING_id != "",
]

cat("Mapped proteins:", nrow(mapped_ok), "\n")
cat("Unmapped proteins:",
    nrow(mapped) - nrow(mapped_ok), "\n")

# Stop if genes map to same STRING ID
if (anyDuplicated(mapped_ok$STRING_id)) {
  stop("Duplicate STRING IDs found. Review the mapping.")
}

# Interactions among mapped proteins
interactions <- string_db$get_interactions(
  mapped_ok$STRING_id
)

# attach gene names and confidence scores
lookup <- setNames(
  mapped_ok$gene_symbol,
  mapped_ok$STRING_id
)

results <- data.frame(
  gene_A = unname(lookup[interactions$from]),
  gene_B = unname(lookup[interactions$to]),
  STRING_id_A = interactions$from,
  STRING_id_B = interactions$to,
  combined_score = interactions$combined_score,
  confidence_score = interactions$combined_score / 1000
)

# removing self interactions and duplicate undirected interactions
results <- results[
  results$STRING_id_A != results$STRING_id_B,
]
pair_key <- paste(
  pmin(results$STRING_id_A, results$STRING_id_B),
  pmax(results$STRING_id_A, results$STRING_id_B),
  sep = "|"
)

results <- results[!duplicated(pair_key), ]
results <- results[
  order(-results$combined_score),
]

# all interactions
write.csv(
  results,
  file.path(output_dir, "STRING_interactions_400.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Total STRING interactions:", nrow(results), "\n")
cat("Step 2 completed.\n")

```

```{r}
  is.na(mapped$STRING_id) | mapped$STRING_id == "",
  c("gene_symbol", "uniprot_accession")
]
print(unmapped)
```

```{r}
# 146 interactions connecting to two groups
# Match each gene to disease classification
groups <- setNames(
  proteins$disease_group,
  proteins$gene_symbol
)

# Keep only edges connecting diff groups
bipartite_edges <- results[
  groups[results$gene_A] != groups[results$gene_B],
]

write.csv(
  bipartite_edges,
  file.path(output_dir, "STRING_bipartite_edges_400.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Bipartite interactions:", nrow(bipartite_edges), "\n")
```
